title: Historical Narratives
text:
PUMPKIN SPICE LATTE

Also now: Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew, Iced Pumpkin Cream Chai, Pumpkin Spice Frappuccino, Iced Pumpkin Cream Shaken Espresso, Pumpkin Spice Chai, and Pumpkin Cream Matcha.

…the Pumpkin Spice that Starbucks turned into one of the most profitable and annoying products in their history. Sbucks sells ~20 million pumpkin spice lattes each year
BTW the 4th ingredient is all allspice: dried and ground berries of the Pimenta dioica (Jamaica pepper, myrtle pepper) tree, now grown around the tropics but originally from carribean and central america. not a blend of spices, named “. Named”all spice” by the English because its flavor combines cinnamon, nutmeg, and nutmeg. Spaniards mistook it for a pepper, hence “Pimenta”
